author: Joseph McBride
title: LPGA Tour legend joins in tributes for Vanessa Trump after breast cancer announcement - NewsBreak
text:
By Joseph McBride ,
1 hours ago LPGA Tour legend Annika Sorenstam offered prayers for Vanessa Trump following her public revelation on Instagram about a recent breast cancer diagnosis.
Trump, formerly wed to Donald Trump Jr. and currently in a relationship with golf great Tiger Woods, disclosed on Wednesday that she'd already undergone surgery and was working on her treatment strategy with doctors. The news surfaced just one week following Woods ' return from a Swiss rehabilitation facility.
A wave of supportive messages from celebrities and politically connected figures flooded Trump's post, with Sorenstam among them. The Hall of Fame golfer, who previously visited the White House and was honored with the Presidential Medal of Freedom by President Donald Trump , expressed her solidarity through an emoji on Instagram.

Sorenstam left a praying hands emoji on Trump's announcement, signaling her support. Haley Cavinder, an American influencer and former Miami basketball standout, also chimed in with, "Praying for you," accompanied by a red heart emoji.
Ivanka Trump, Vanessa's former sister-in-law, added: "Praying for your continued strength and a swift recovery. Love you mama."
In her heartfelt statement, Trump shared, "I've recently been diagnosed with breast cancer. While this isn't news anyone expects, I'm working closely with my medical team on a treatment plan.
"I would like to thank my doctors for performing a procedure earlier this week on me. I am staying focused and hopeful while surrounded by the love and support of my family, my kids, and those closest to me.
"Thank you for your kindness and support it truly means more than I can express. I kindly ask for privacy as I focus on my health and recovery. Vanessa."
Trump has endured a turbulent stretch, as Woods was taken into custody in March following a car accident and held on suspicion of DUI. He subsequently entered a treatment facility in Zurich, Switzerland, before heading back to Florida last week.
Woods showed up at Kai Trump's high school graduation ceremony at the Benjamin School, standing alongside Vanessa and her daughter. His own children also attend the private institution, which is where he first connected with Trump, and the pair went public with their relationship in 2024.
According to People , Woods approached his recent Switzerland stint with genuine commitment. A source revealed to the publication, "Tiger took his trip seriously and is all about continuing his recovery and putting this chapter behind him. He is in good spirits and also can't wait to put the legal issues to rest."
The source further indicated that despite Trump's disappointment with the circumstances, their bond remains strong and the setback hasn't damaged their relationship. "Vanessa and Tiger are in love, still serious, and happy to see each other," the source maintained.
The source added that Trump is "eager to help him continue with his progress and move beyond any more public scandals - which they both dislike intensely."
